name: Dual-mode tabs / accordion

geometry.desktop: tab strip driving an absolutely-positioned card in the next column
geometry.le991: collapses to an accordion driven by a CSS sibling selector

responsive.desktop: tab strip + card in adjacent column
responsive.le991: accordion; .tab-content-mask animates max-height 300ms with a 100ms delay on OPEN only, no delay on close
responsive.le479: active trigger's top corners animate 99px -> 20px over 300ms

notes: There is NO separate FAQ-style accordion anywhere on these pages — no accordion/faq/disclosure class exists in the stylesheet for this widget.

CASCADE: a.tab-trigger{display:flex} is required. A bare .tab-trigger{display:flex} LOSES at equal specificity to index.css's .w-inline-block{display:inline-block}, which measurably made the pills 60.8px instead of 48px and shifted everything below them. See docs/CASCADE.md.
